t: Ezeh debarim qeruyin hessach haddaat basseuda shetztzarik lachazor ulebarek
s: Ezeh debarim qeruyin hessach haddaat basseuda shetztzarik lachazor ulebarek, ubo ch' seipim: gamar seudato vehesiru hallechem vekol hammaakal meal hashshulchan, o gam hashshulchan atzmo kemo shehayu nohagin bimehem, veratza lachazor laakilato — en tzarik lebarek bitchilla "hammotzi" velo beraka acheret al debarim habbaim mechamat hasseuda, vaapillu gamar belibbo shello leekol od veachar kak nimlak. Veap al pi shebbekol maqom nimlak zaquq lachazor ulebarek — basseuda eno ken, lepi sheyyesh qeba lasseuda, kelomar sheadam qobea atzmo aleha vedarko lehimmashek bah ulehiggarer meakila laakila, upeamim sheadam yosheb bisuda qetanna umamshik lisuda gedola, lepikak ap sheggamar belibbo shello leekol od — en zeh silluq vehessach haddaat, kevan sheddarko shel adam lihyot nimlak lipamim bisudato. Veen nimlak zaquq beraka basseuda, ella im ken beshaa shebberak "hammotzi" lo haya lo ella meat lechem velo haya yodea kelal bishat habberaka sheyyihyeh lo yoter achar kak veal daat ken berak "hammotzi" veachar kak natenu lo yoter, o sheachar kak nimlak liqqach, kemo shennitbaer besiman qs"t vqa"d. Veken shear maakalim sheyyadua shebbishat birkat "hammotzi" lo haya dato alehem kelal, keinyan shennitbaer besiman qa"z. Vaapillu lechem ushear debarim shehayeta dato alehem, ella sheggamar leekol veaqar mimmeqomo vehissiach dato milleekol od, keshechozer lisudato — tzarik lachazor ulebarek, lepi sheen dato shel adam lehiggarer meakila laakila, ella kesheyyosheb bimqom qebiut seudato velo kesheyyotze lemaqom acher:

Vekol zeh baakila, abal bishtiyya im gamar belibbo shello lishtot od veachar kak nimlak — tzarik lachazor ulebarek. Vaapillu lo gamar belibbo beperush, ella amar: tenu kos unebarek birkat hammazon. Vehu haddin im amar: bou unebarek birkat hammazon belo kos — hare zeh silluq vehessach haddaat mishshetiyya, veim achar kak nimlak lishtot — tzarik lebarek battechilla, abal im nimlak vechozer laakilato — okel belo beraka. Veim mechamat akila zo nigrar lishtot — shoteh gam ken belo beraka. Abal im tzame lishtot mechamat akilato harishona — tzarik lebarek, sheap shehashshetiyya tepela eleha — en zeh moil leinyan hessach haddaat venimlak, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman [ry"b], abal en tzarik lebarek beraka acharona:

Veken im nimlak leekol shear debarim habbaim mechamat hasseuda, ap sheen bedato leekol pat kelal — en tzarik lebarek alehem, shekkevan sheim ratza leekol pat en tzarik lebarek "hammotzi" — enah kisuda acheret bizman hazzeh sheen nohagin lehasir hashshulchan qodem birkat hammazon, kemo shennitbaer besiman qa"z:

Veyesh omerim sheakila ushetiyya shavin, shekkevan sheamar: "nebarek birkat hammazon" — hare zeh silluq vehessach haddaat mehasseuda, veim nimlak leekol — tzarik lebarek "hammotzi". Veen tzarik lomar im hissiach dato beperush, ap al pi shello amar "nebarek birkat hammazon". Vekol shekken shetztzarik lebarek al shear debarim habbaim mechamat hasseuda lipnehem vegam leacharehem kol shessilleq dato mehappat, o sheamar: "nebarek birkat hammazon", shekkevan sheim ratza lachazor veleekol tzarik lachazor ulebarek "hammotzi" — kisuda acheret hi ap al pi shello sillequ hashshulchan, velaken en birkat hammazon poteret otah, kemo shennitbaer besiman qa"z. Uleinyan halaka, sepeq berakot lehaqel:

Uledibre hakkol, im natal hakkos beyado lebarek birkat hammazon, ap al pi shello natal yadayv, vegam lo amar mittechilla: "tenu kos unebarek birkat hammazon" — hare zeh silluq vehessach haddaat legamre meakila ushetiyya, vetzarik lebarek alehem, vegam beraka acharona tzarik lebarek al shear debarim habbaim mechamat hasseuda qodem birkat hammazon, veen birkat hammazon potartan, shekkisuda acheret hi, kevan shessilleq dato mehappat. Veim natal yadayv mayim acharonim, ap al pi shello natal hakkos — hare zeh silluq vehessach haddaat legamre, vetzarik lebarek. Vaapillu bibraka eno rashshay leekol velo lishtot, mishshum hepseq ben mayim acharonim lebirkat hammazon, ella im ken rotzeh lachazor velittol mayim acharonim achar kak samuk lebirkat hammazon, shemmayim harishonim naasu kemayim bealma, veen lechoshbam lismok lahem birkat hammazon ap shennetalam betorat acharonim. Vekol maqom shetztzarik lachazor ulebarek "hammotzi" mishshum hessach haddaat — tzarik lachazor velittol yadayv karauy laakilat pat, shekkevan shehissiach dato meakilat pat — hissiach dato mishshemirat yadayv. (Umayim haacharonim enam moilim lo laakilat pat ap im netalan karauy, hoil velo nitkavven bahem laakilat pat, kemo shennitbaer besiman qn"ch):

Im baal hasseuda amar: "nebarek birkat hammazon" — kol hamsubbin asurim lishtot belo beraka. Vehu sheshshatequ vehiskimu lidbarayv, abal im echad mehaorechim o mibbene beto amar ken — apillu haomer atzmo yakol lachazor bo velishtot im baal habbayit, lepi sheeno oseh hessach haddaat baamirato, mippene sheyyodea sheen haddabar taluy bo ella bebaal habbayit, vekevan shebbaal habbayit lo asa hessach haddaat — ap hu dato someket al baal habbayit lishtot immo:

Veken haqqeruim bebayit baal habbayit leekol mine perot, ap al pi shemmebiin lahem bazeh achar zeh — en tzarik lebarek ella al harishon. Veap al pi shebbishat habberaka lo hayu yodein kamma yabiu lahem, kevan sheddatam al baal hasseuda shezzimmenan, im ken kol mah shehu mebi lipnehem hayeta datam alehem lemaprea, kevan shehayeta datam alayv. Abal im ba alehem ish echad shello zimmenuhu veeno qobea atzmo immahem ella niknas etzlam lepi shaa vekol echad mehamsubbim moshit lo kos o mine perot — tzarik lebarek al kol echad veechad im moshitim lo achar shekkebar berak al kos shellepanayv, vaapillu adayin lo shetao kullo. Veakshav shehamminhag hu shemmoshitim kosot harbeh lemi shenniknas bimsibba haqqebuim lishtiyya — en tzarik lebarek ella al kos harishon, kemo shennitbaer besiman qa"d:

Achar kol akilateka — ekol melach, veachar kol shetiyyateka — sheteh mayim, vei atta nizzoq. Akal kol maakal velo akal melach, shata kol mashqeh velo shata mayim, bayyom — yidag mippene reach happeh, uballayla — mippene reach happeh umippene askera. Vekol hammaqpeh akilato bemayim — eno ba lide choli meayim. Vehaokel melach achar akilato — lo yokal baggudal, mippene sheqqasheh leqibbur banim, velo bazzeret, mippene sheqqasheh laaniyyut, velo baetzba, sheqqasheh lishchin ra, ella baamma ubaqqemitza. Veakshav lo nahagu kelal baakilat melach achar seuda, veen nizzoqin, mippene shennishtannu hattebaim, kemo shennitbaer besiman qa"g:
